name: DB Securities Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Seoul, South Korea, DB Financial Investment Co., Ltd. has been delivering a broad spectrum of financial products and services since its inception in 1982. The company's diverse offerings span asset management, various insurance products (including life insurance), savings bank facilities, and brokerage services. It also specializes in bond dealing, investment banking (IB), investment trusts, and extends its reach into international business operations. Furthermore, the firm manages mid to long-term investments, conducts trading in stocks and derivatives, facilitates asset transactions, and provides crucial tax, legal, and risk management advice to its clients.
